method.name: resolveIssueId
method.purpose: Returns the tracker's internal numeric id of an issue given its ref, so a creator that adopted an issue by label (after a create that timed out) can still link it as a sub-issue of its parent, which GitHub does by internal id and not by issue number. Additive; the GitHub adapter test is s1's to add.

body.rationale: After a create that times out, the next call finds the issue by its per-unit label and has only its ref, so the native sub-issue link under the parent cannot be made. s4 records a pending link only when it knows the id (a successful create). A ref-to-id lookup lets the adopted issue be linked too.
